The '''Vanan system''' was located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Vanan]], which was home to [[Magma/Legends|lava]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="SW88" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vanan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-19.<ref name="TEA" />
